title: Jesus Calls Matthew

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In Capernaum there was a tax booth by the road. Tax collectors took money for the Romans, and many people thought of them as cheats.

bsb: As Jesus went on from there, He saw a man named Matthew sitting at the tax booth.
kjv: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him,

bsb: and Matthew got up and followed Him.
kjv: And he arose, and followed him.

puzzle.hint: He was sitting at the tax booth.

scenes.title: Dinner with Sinners
scenes.note: Matthew's Gospel puts the Sermon on the Mount before Matthew's call, because Matthew groups Jesus' teaching together. This game follows the order in Mark and Luke.

bsb: Why does your Teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?
kjv: Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?

bsb: It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick. But go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice.’ For I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.
kjv: They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick. But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

kjv: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

reflect: Jesus calls people others look down on. No one is too far away for Him.
discuss: Why were people surprised that Jesus chose a tax collector?
Jesus said the sick need a doctor. In what way do all of us need Jesus?
Is there someone people leave out whom you could be kind to this week?
prayer: Jesus, thank You for calling sinners like us. Help us show mercy to people others leave out. Amen.
